{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A tailored wool crepe skirt suit jacket, structured fit, knee-length hem, charcoal gray (#2F343A), heavy wool.
Wide-leg trousers with a pleated front, straight cut from hip to ankle, charcoal gray (#2F343A), heavy wool crepe.
A crisp high-neck silk blouse, relaxed silhouette reaching the hips, bone white (#F5F5DC), fine woven silk.
Silver filigree stud earrings, small disc shape with intricate wirework details, sterling silver.
A delicate silver chain necklace, single strand resting at the collarbone, polished sterling silver.
Opaque charcoal tights, sheer finish for subtle texture, charcoal gray (#2F343A), nylon and spandex blend.
Conservative pointed-toe pumps, low moderate heel height in a block style, matte leather, dark brown (#4E3B2C).
This outfit works because the matching suit jacket and trousers provide the formal dignity required for a funeral while the wool fabric respects the autumn season. The bone-white silk blouse offers a respectful yet understated contrast against the dark charcoal tones, avoiding anything that looks too bright or festive for mourning. Silver jewelry honors her specific wish for this metal while maintaining a somber elegance appropriate for a Thursday morning service."}
